# Zamera (0.1.7+8)
> Zamera — True-Color Artwork Photography, Pro DSLR Camera & Unified Cinema Video Application by Akarworks.

## What is Zamera?
Zamera is a cross-platform true-color photography, manual DSLR camera, and unified cinema video application developed by Akarworks for iOS 17.0+ and Android 10+. Engineered for 100% offline processing, zero telemetry, and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Zamera unifies four studio modes inside one app: Art Mode calibration with a 24-patch ColorChecker CIEDE2000 solver (targeting Delta E00 <= 1.0), manual PASM exposure with 1/3-EV stops, 14-bit Bayer RAW and Apple ProRAW capture, computational Portrait bokeh, and 180-degree shutter-locked 10-bit Pro Video (Rec.709, Apple Log, ProRes 422 HQ, HLG10). Version 0.1.7+8 delivers hardened StoreKit 2 / Google Play Billing lifecycle verification, bilingual TR/EN support, rust FFI safety, and a 30-day free trial for Zamera Pro alongside daily free TrueColor/RAW/Sticker quotas with zero cloud uploads. Zamera preserves full local KVKK, GDPR, and CCPA privacy with zero third-party trackers.

## Pricing & Zero-Telemetry Monetization
- **Free Core & Daily Aha Allowances:** Hardware Probe, standard JPEG/HEIF Pro Photo, Portrait mode, 4K/1080p Rec.709 Pro Video, live Art Mode A/B inspection, and daily free allowances (1 TrueColor Art shot, 1 DNG RAW capture/share, and 3 transparent PNG sticker exports per day) are available for free.
- **Zamera Pro (Hybrid Freemium):** Includes a **1-Month (30-Day) Free Trial** on the Annual Pro plan ($19.99/yr), an optional Launch Lifetime Pro buyout ($34.99 launch / $49.99 regular), and a Monthly Pro plan ($3.99/mo), processed strictly on-device via StoreKit 2 and Google Play Billing with zero third-party analytics SDKs.
